settings.c_order: Go then C within each language process; alternating baseline/head process order by seed
settings.limitation: Shared local CPU; C Go-C-C-Go cycles and percentile/real-file campaign remain unverified

rss.method: Single parser benchmark binary under /usr/bin/time -v; compilation excluded; GOMAXPROCS=1; count=1; benchtime=750ms; benchmark includes initial tree and cycling edited trees

fleet_checks: incremental=fresh Go at each edit step
correctness.malformed_julia_c_parity: Pre-existing fresh-Go recovery gap remains; incremental=fresh-Go witness passes

profile_method: CPU samples classified by stack: Tree.Edit; incremental frames containing reuseCursor/reuseNode/canReuseNode; remaining incremental frames. Percentages exclude initial parse, grammar loading, release, and background runtime samples. Two-second profiled benchmarks are attribution evidence, not timing comparisons.
